name: To Five ~Natsu no Tobira no Mukou ni Kimi o Mitsukeru~
original_name: ＴＯ ＦＩＶＥ ～夏の扉の向こうに君を見つける～
source:
Protagonist is a graduating high school student who has only one summer left to create memories till his life changes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-august-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名即将毕业的高中生。在人生迎来改变之前，他只剩下最后一个夏天，可以留下属于自己的回忆。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-august-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
